content.json:
## AVD Session Host Replacer - Enterprise Dashboard

Last-reported telemetry from the selected workload workspace only. Use **Invocations** for current initiator and reconciliation worker execution drill-down, including idle, successful and failed invocations.

---

parameters.name: ApplicationInsights
parameters.query:
resources
| where type == 'microsoft.insights/components'
| where tostring(properties.WorkspaceResourceId) =~ '{WorkloadWorkspace}'
| extend ParentResourceId = tostring(tags['cm-resource-parent'])
| order by name asc
| project value = id, label = name, selected = (name contains 'sessionhostreplacer' or (name endswith '-insights' and ParentResourceId contains '/providers/Microsoft.DesktopVirtualization/hostPools/'))
parameters.label: Application Insights

parameters.name: HostPool
parameters.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.desktopvirtualization/hostpools'
| distinct name
| project value = name, label = name, selected = false
| union (datatable(value:string, label:string, selected:bool) [
    "*", "All Host Pools", true
])
| order by selected desc, label asc
parameters.label: Host Pool

parameters.name: Cycle
parameters.label: SHR Cycle
parameters.query:
let traces = AppTraces
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where _ResourceId in~ ({ApplicationInsights})
| extend timestamp = TimeGenerated, message = Message, severityLevel = SeverityLevel,
    customDimensions = Properties, cloud_RoleName = AppRoleName, cloud_RoleInstance = AppRoleInstance,
    operation_Id = OperationId, operation_Name = OperationName, itemCount = ItemCount;
let hostPoolFilter = '{HostPool}';
traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where message contains 'SHR_EVENT |'
| extend Data = parse_json(extract(@"SHR_EVENT \| (\{.*\})$", 1, message))
| where toint(Data.SchemaVersion) == 1
| extend HostPoolName = extract(@"\[([^\]]+)\]", 1, message), CycleId = tostring(Data.CycleId), FunctionApp = coalesce(tostring(Data.FunctionApp), cloud_RoleName)
| where CycleId matches regex @"^[a-f0-9]{32}$"
| where hostPoolFilter == '*' or HostPoolName == hostPoolFilter
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by CycleId
| order by timestamp desc
| project value = CycleId, label = strcat(HostPoolName, ' | ', FunctionApp, ' | ', format_datetime(timestamp, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), ' | ', tostring(Data.Status), ' | ', CycleId), selected = false
| union (datatable(value:string, label:string, selected:bool) ['*', 'All cycles in time range', true])

parameters.name: Invocation
parameters.label: Invocation (cycle logs)
parameters.query:
let traces = AppTraces
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where _ResourceId in~ ({ApplicationInsights})
| extend timestamp = TimeGenerated, message = Message, severityLevel = SeverityLevel,
    customDimensions = Properties, cloud_RoleName = AppRoleName, cloud_RoleInstance = AppRoleInstance,
    operation_Id = OperationId, operation_Name = OperationName, itemCount = ItemCount;
let hostPoolFilter = '{HostPool}';
traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| extend HostPoolName = extract(@"\[([^\]]+)\]", 1, message), CycleId = extract(@"\[Cycle:([a-f0-9]{32})\]", 1, message), InvocationId = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions.InvocationId), tostring(customDimensions['prop__InvocationId']))
| where isnotempty(CycleId)
| where hostPoolFilter == '*' or HostPoolName == hostPoolFilter
| where '{Cycle}' == '*' or CycleId == '{Cycle}'
| where isnotempty(InvocationId)
| summarize FirstSeen = min(timestamp) by InvocationId
| order by FirstSeen desc
| project value = InvocationId, label = strcat(format_datetime(FirstSeen, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), ' | ', InvocationId), selected = false
| union (datatable(value:string, label:string, selected:bool) ['*', 'All cycle invocations', true])

parameters.name: DashboardPage
parameters.query:
datatable(value:string, label:string, selected:bool) [
    "operations", "Operations", true,
    "configuration", "Configuration", false,
    "invocations", "Invocations", false
]
parameters.label: Page

content.query:
let traces = AppTraces
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where _ResourceId in~ ({ApplicationInsights})
| extend timestamp = TimeGenerated, message = Message, severityLevel = SeverityLevel,
    customDimensions = Properties, cloud_RoleName = AppRoleName, cloud_RoleInstance = AppRoleInstance,
    operation_Id = OperationId, operation_Name = OperationName, itemCount = ItemCount;
let hostPoolFilter = '{HostPool}';
let settings = traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where message contains "SETTINGS |"
| extend HostPoolName = extract(@"\[([^\]]+)\]", 1, message)
| where isnotempty(HostPoolName)
| where hostPoolFilter == '*' or HostPoolName == hostPoolFilter
| extend ReplacementMode = extract(@"ReplacementMode: ([A-Za-z]+)", 1, message)
| extend MinimumDrainMinutes = extract(@"MinimumDrainMinutes: (\d+)", 1, message)
| extend DrainGracePeriodHours = extract(@"DrainGracePeriodHours: (\d+)", 1, message)
| extend MinimumCapacityPercent = extract(@"MinimumCapacityPercent: ([\d\/A-Za-z]+)", 1, message)
| extend MaxDeletionsPerCycle = extract(@"MaxDeletionsPerCycle: ([\d\/A-Za-z]+)", 1, message)
| extend EnableProgressiveScaleUp = extract(@"EnableProgressiveScaleUp: ([A-Za-z]+)", 1, message)
| extend InitialDeploymentPercent = extract(@"InitialDeploymentPercent: ([\d\/A-Za-z]+)", 1, message)
| extend ScaleUpIncrementPercent = extract(@"ScaleUpIncrementPercent: ([\d\/A-Za-z]+)", 1, message)
| extend SuccessfulRunsBeforeScaleUp = extract(@"SuccessfulRunsBeforeScaleUp: ([\d\/A-Za-z]+)", 1, message)
| extend MaxDeploymentBatchSize = extract(@"MaxDeploymentBatchSize: ([\d\/A-Za-z]+)", 1, message)
| extend MinimumHostIndex = extract(@"MinimumHostIndex: ([\d\/A-Za-z]+)", 1, message)
| extend EnableShutdownRetention = extract(@"EnableShutdownRetention: ([A-Za-z\/]+)", 1, message)
| extend ShutdownRetentionDays = extract(@"ShutdownRetentionDays: ([\d\/A-Za-z]+)", 1, message)
| extend TargetSessionHostCount = extract(@"TargetSessionHostCount: ([\d\/A-Za-z]+)", 1, message)
| extend FunctionAppResourceId = extract(@"FunctionAppResourceId: ([^|]+)$", 1, message)
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by HostPoolName
| project HostPoolName, ReplacementMode, MinimumDrainMinutes, DrainGracePeriodHours, MinimumCapacityPercent, MaxDeletionsPerCycle, EnableProgressiveScaleUp, InitialDeploymentPercent, ScaleUpIncrementPercent, SuccessfulRunsBeforeScaleUp, MaxDeploymentBatchSize, MinimumHostIndex, EnableShutdownRetention, ShutdownRetentionDays, TargetSessionHostCount, FunctionAppResourceId;
let scaling = traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where message contains "Dynamic capacity from scaling plan:" or message contains "No active scaling plan schedule found"
| extend HostPoolName = extract(@"\[([^\]]+)\]", 1, message)
| where isnotempty(HostPoolName)
| where hostPoolFilter == '*' or HostPoolName == hostPoolFilter
| extend ScalingTarget = extract(@"Dynamic capacity from scaling plan: (\d+)%", 1, message)
| extend ScalingPhase = iff(message contains "No active scaling plan schedule found", "Static fallback", extract(@"Phase: ([^)]+)\)", 1, message))
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by HostPoolName
| project HostPoolName, ScalingTarget, ScalingPhase;
settings
| join kind=leftouter scaling on HostPoolName
| extend ScalingPhase = iff(isempty(ScalingPhase), "Unknown", ScalingPhase)
| extend EffectiveBehavior = case(
    ScalingPhase == "Static fallback" and ReplacementMode == "DeleteFirst", "Static safety floor applies; replacement is not phase-frozen",
    ScalingPhase == "Static fallback", "No evaluable scaling schedule; configured batch limits apply",
    ScalingPhase contains "RampUp" or ScalingPhase == "Peak", iff(ReplacementMode == "DeleteFirst", "New delete/deploy batches frozen; recovery continues", "Capacity-safe SideBySide removal permitted; active scaling target applies"),
    ReplacementMode == "DeleteFirst", "DeleteFirst replacement permitted; active scaling target and one-host floor apply",
    "SideBySide deployment and old-host removal are permitted")
| project 
    ['Host Pool'] = HostPoolName,
    ['Replacement Mode'] = ReplacementMode,
    ['Scaling Phase'] = ScalingPhase,
    ['Scaling Target'] = iff(isempty(ScalingTarget), "N/A", strcat(ScalingTarget, "%")),
    ['Effective Behavior'] = EffectiveBehavior,
    ['Min Drain (min)'] = MinimumDrainMinutes,
    ['Grace Period (hrs)'] = DrainGracePeriodHours,
    ['Target Count'] = case(TargetSessionHostCount == "0" or TargetSessionHostCount == "Auto", "Auto-Detect", TargetSessionHostCount),
    ['Progressive Scale-Up'] = case(EnableProgressiveScaleUp == "True", strcat("✅ Enabled (", InitialDeploymentPercent, "% → +", ScaleUpIncrementPercent, "% every ", SuccessfulRunsBeforeScaleUp, " success)"), "❌ Disabled"),
    ['Min Capacity %'] = case(ReplacementMode == "DeleteFirst", strcat(MinimumCapacityPercent, "%"), "N/A"),
    ['Max Deletions/Cycle'] = case(ReplacementMode == "DeleteFirst", MaxDeletionsPerCycle, "N/A"),
    ['Max Batch Size'] = case(ReplacementMode == "SideBySide", MaxDeploymentBatchSize, "N/A"),
    ['Min Host Index'] = MinimumHostIndex,
    ['Shutdown Retention'] = case(ReplacementMode == "SideBySide" and EnableShutdownRetention == "True", strcat("✅ Enabled (", ShutdownRetentionDays, " days)"), ReplacementMode == "SideBySide" and EnableShutdownRetention != "True", "❌ Disabled", "N/A"),
    ['Manage Function App'] = FunctionAppResourceId
content.title: Function App Settings

content.query:
let traces = AppTraces
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where _ResourceId in~ ({ApplicationInsights})
| extend timestamp = TimeGenerated, message = Message, severityLevel = SeverityLevel,
    customDimensions = Properties, cloud_RoleName = AppRoleName, cloud_RoleInstance = AppRoleInstance,
    operation_Id = OperationId, operation_Name = OperationName, itemCount = ItemCount;
traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where message contains "SETTINGS |"
| extend HostPoolName = extract(@"\[([^\]]+)\]", 1, message)
| where isnotempty(HostPoolName)
| where '{HostPool}' == '*' or HostPoolName == '{HostPool}'
| extend IncludeExcludedImageVersions = extract(@"IncludeExcludedImageVersions: ([A-Za-z]+)", 1, message)
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by HostPoolName
| project ['Host Pool'] = HostPoolName, ['Gallery Selection Policy'] = case(IncludeExcludedImageVersions =~ 'true', 'Pilot: includes globally and regionally excluded versions', IncludeExcludedImageVersions =~ 'false', 'Production: honors global and regional exclusions', 'Unknown: requires upgraded runtime and a fresh execution'), ['Last Execution'] = timestamp
content.title: Pilot Image Selection Policy

content.json:
> **Change configuration safely:** use `Set-SessionHostReplacerConfiguration.ps1` to review current operational settings, preview validated changes, and preserve unrelated Function App settings. Replacement mode, timer schedule, identity, networking, and deployment resources remain managed by the Template Spec.

> **Schedule maintenance:** publish the **Schedule AVD Session Host Maintenance** Template Spec, select it from the **Maintenance Scheduler** parameter, and use the action below. The operation schedules an existing DeleteFirst replacer without redeploying it.

parameters.name: MaintenanceTemplateSpec
parameters.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/templatespecs'
| where tostring(properties.displayName) == 'Schedule AVD Session Host Maintenance'
| order by name asc
| project value = id, label = strcat(name, ' (', resourceGroup, ')'), selected = true
parameters.label: Maintenance Scheduler

content.json:
### Trace a replacement cycle
Select a host pool, then an **SHR Cycle**. Use **Invocation (cycle logs)** to narrow the log detail; reset it to **All cycle invocations** when changing cycles.

A cycle ID is the durable SHR operation ID, not Application Insights' native operation ID. A cycle can span many timer invocations and, in SideBySide, multiple scheduled batches. The summary and timeline remain cycle-wide when an invocation is selected. Deployment links open the existing ARM deployment; they do not submit a deployment.

**Last reported state is not a live Table read.** Check observation age, lease expiry and the separate timer-health table. A live lease can legitimately defer reconciliation after interruption. Waiting for scheduled authorization does not stop retirement already authorized. Inventory tiles show the last engine observation, not the result of every idle timer tick.

These views require the updated runtime and fresh telemetry. No events in the selected time range is **not** proof that a pool is up to date. Expand the time range to include the cycle's start. Sampling, ingestion delay or a missing completion event can leave gaps; a stale observation is not proof of failure.

content.query:
let traces = AppTraces
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where _ResourceId in~ ({ApplicationInsights})
| extend timestamp = TimeGenerated, message = Message, severityLevel = SeverityLevel,
    customDimensions = Properties, cloud_RoleName = AppRoleName, cloud_RoleInstance = AppRoleInstance,
    operation_Id = OperationId, operation_Name = OperationName, itemCount = ItemCount;
let hostPoolFilter = '{HostPool}';
traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where message contains 'SHR_EVENT |'
| extend Data = parse_json(extract(@"SHR_EVENT \| (\{.*\})$", 1, message))
| where toint(Data.SchemaVersion) == 1
| extend HostPoolName = extract(@"\[([^\]]+)\]", 1, message), CycleId = tostring(Data.CycleId), FunctionApp = coalesce(tostring(Data.FunctionApp), cloud_RoleName)
| where CycleId matches regex @"^[a-f0-9]{32}$"
| where hostPoolFilter == '*' or HostPoolName == hostPoolFilter
| where '{Cycle}' == '*' or CycleId == '{Cycle}'
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by CycleId
| extend LeaseExpires = todatetime(Data.LeaseExpiresUtc), Deadline = todatetime(Data.DeadlineUtc)
| project ['Last Observed'] = timestamp, ['Host Pool'] = HostPoolName, ['Function App'] = FunctionApp, ['Cycle ID'] = CycleId,
    Status = tostring(Data.Status), Activity = replace_regex(tostring(Data.Phase), @"([a-z])([A-Z])", @"\1 \2"),
    Batch = toint(Data.Batch), Reason = tostring(Data.Reason), Image = tostring(Data.ImageVersion), ['Image Definition'] = tostring(Data.ImageDefinition), Target = toint(Data.Target),
    Started = todatetime(Data.StartedUtc), Deadline, ['Observation Age (min)'] = datetime_diff('minute', now(), timestamp),
    ['Initiation'] = iff(tobool(Data.InitiationEnabled), 'Enabled', 'Held'),
    ['Lease'] = case(tobool(Data.LeaseHeld) and LeaseExpires > now(), 'Owned - other invocations must wait', tobool(Data.LeaseHeld), 'Expired - takeover eligible', 'Released'),
    ['Lease Expires'] = LeaseExpires, ['In Drain (last observation)'] = toint(Data.InDrain),
    Deployment = tostring(Data.DeploymentName), ['Open deployment'] = tostring(Data.DeploymentResourceId),
    ['Supersedes Cycle'] = tostring(Data.SupersedesCycleId)
| order by ['Last Observed'] desc
| take 100
content.title: SHR Cycles - Last Reported State

content.query:
let traces = AppTraces
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where _ResourceId in~ ({ApplicationInsights})
| extend timestamp = TimeGenerated, message = Message, severityLevel = SeverityLevel,
    customDimensions = Properties, cloud_RoleName = AppRoleName, cloud_RoleInstance = AppRoleInstance,
    operation_Id = OperationId, operation_Name = OperationName, itemCount = ItemCount;
let hostPoolFilter = '{HostPool}';
traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where message contains 'SHR_EVENT |'
| extend Data = parse_json(extract(@"SHR_EVENT \| (\{.*\})$", 1, message))
| where toint(Data.SchemaVersion) == 1
| extend HostPoolName = extract(@"\[([^\]]+)\]", 1, message), CycleId = tostring(Data.CycleId), FunctionApp = coalesce(tostring(Data.FunctionApp), cloud_RoleName)
| where CycleId matches regex @"^[a-f0-9]{32}$"
| where hostPoolFilter == '*' or HostPoolName == hostPoolFilter
| where '{Cycle}' == '*' or CycleId == '{Cycle}'
| extend InvocationId = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions.InvocationId), tostring(customDimensions['prop__InvocationId']))
| project Timestamp = timestamp, ['Host Pool'] = HostPoolName, ['Cycle ID'] = CycleId, Trigger = tostring(Data.Trigger),
    Batch = toint(Data.Batch), Event = tostring(Data.Event), Activity = replace_regex(tostring(Data.Phase), @"([a-z])([A-Z])", @"\1 \2"),
    Status = tostring(Data.Status), Reason = tostring(Data.Reason), Image = tostring(Data.ImageVersion), ['Image Definition'] = tostring(Data.ImageDefinition), Deployment = tostring(Data.DeploymentName),
    ['Open deployment'] = tostring(Data.DeploymentResourceId), ['Invocation ID'] = InvocationId, ['Native Operation ID'] = operation_Id
| order by Timestamp desc
| take 300
| order by Timestamp asc
content.title: Cycle Timeline - Latest 300 Events in Chronological Order

content.query:
let traces = AppTraces
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where _ResourceId in~ ({ApplicationInsights})
| extend timestamp = TimeGenerated, message = Message, severityLevel = SeverityLevel,
    customDimensions = Properties, cloud_RoleName = AppRoleName, cloud_RoleInstance = AppRoleInstance,
    operation_Id = OperationId, operation_Name = OperationName, itemCount = ItemCount;
let exceptions = AppExceptions
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where _ResourceId in~ ({ApplicationInsights})
| extend timestamp = TimeGenerated, outerMessage = OuterMessage, innermostMessage = InnermostMessage,
    severityLevel = SeverityLevel, customDimensions = Properties, cloud_RoleName = AppRoleName,
    cloud_RoleInstance = AppRoleInstance, operation_Id = OperationId, type = ExceptionType, details = Details;
let hostPoolFilter = '{HostPool}';
let cycleInvocations =
traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| extend HostPoolName = extract(@"\[([^\]]+)\]", 1, message), CycleId = extract(@"\[Cycle:([a-f0-9]{32})\]", 1, message), InvocationId = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions.InvocationId), tostring(customDimensions['prop__InvocationId']))
| where isnotempty(CycleId)
| where hostPoolFilter == '*' or HostPoolName == hostPoolFilter
| where '{Cycle}' == '*' or CycleId == '{Cycle}'
| extend Source = tostring(column_ifexists('_ResourceId', '')), NativeKey = iff(isnotempty(InvocationId), strcat('inv:', InvocationId), strcat('op:', operation_Id))
| where NativeKey !in ('inv:', 'op:')
| where '{Invocation}' == '*' or InvocationId == '{Invocation}'
| summarize by Source, NativeKey, CycleId, HostPoolName;
union traces, exceptions
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| extend InvocationId = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions.InvocationId), tostring(customDimensions['prop__InvocationId'])), Source = tostring(column_ifexists('_ResourceId', ''))
| extend NativeKey = iff(isnotempty(InvocationId), strcat('inv:', InvocationId), strcat('op:', operation_Id))
| join kind=inner cycleInvocations on Source, NativeKey
| project Timestamp = timestamp, ['Host Pool'] = HostPoolName, ['Cycle ID'] = CycleId, ['Invocation ID'] = InvocationId,
    ['Native Operation ID'] = operation_Id, Severity = severityLevel, Message = coalesce(message, outerMessage, innermostMessage)
| order by Timestamp desc
| take 500
| order by Timestamp asc
content.title: Cycle Invocation Logs - Latest 500 Records in Chronological Order

content.query:
let traces = AppTraces
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where _ResourceId in~ ({ApplicationInsights})
| extend timestamp = TimeGenerated, message = Message, severityLevel = SeverityLevel,
    customDimensions = Properties, cloud_RoleName = AppRoleName, cloud_RoleInstance = AppRoleInstance,
    operation_Id = OperationId, operation_Name = OperationName, itemCount = ItemCount;
let hostPoolFilter = '{HostPool}';
traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where message contains 'METRICS |'
| extend HostPoolName = extract(@"\[([^\]]+)\]", 1, message)
| where hostPoolFilter == '*' or HostPoolName == hostPoolFilter
| summarize ['Last Inventory Observation'] = max(timestamp) by HostPoolName, cloud_RoleName
| project ['Host Pool'] = HostPoolName, ['Function App'] = cloud_RoleName, ['Last Inventory Observation'],
    ['Observation Age (min)'] = datetime_diff('minute', now(), ['Last Inventory Observation'])
content.title: Inventory Freshness - Not a Timer Heartbeat

content.query:
let traces = AppTraces
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where _ResourceId in~ ({ApplicationInsights})
| extend timestamp = TimeGenerated, message = Message, severityLevel = SeverityLevel,
    customDimensions = Properties, cloud_RoleName = AppRoleName, cloud_RoleInstance = AppRoleInstance,
    operation_Id = OperationId, operation_Name = OperationName, itemCount = ItemCount;
let hostPoolFilter = '{HostPool}';
traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where message contains "METRICS"
| extend HostPoolName = extract(@"\[([^\]]+)\]", 1, message)
| where isnotempty(HostPoolName)
| where hostPoolFilter == '*' or HostPoolName == hostPoolFilter
| extend Total = toint(extract(@"Total:\s*(\d+)", 1, message))
| extend Enabled = toint(extract(@"Enabled:\s*(\d+)", 1, message))
| extend Target = toint(extract(@"Target:\s*(\d+)", 1, message))
| extend ToReplace = toint(extract(@"ToReplace:\s*(\d+)", 1, message))
| extend InDrain = toint(extract(@"InDrain:\s*(\d+)", 1, message))
| extend PendingDelete = toint(extract(@"PendingDelete:\s*(\d+)", 1, message))
| extend ShutdownRetention = toint(extract(@"ShutdownRetention:\s*(\d+)", 1, message))
| extend ToDeployNow = toint(extract(@"ToDeployNow:\s*(\d+)", 1, message))
| extend RunningDeployments = toint(extract(@"RunningDeployments:\s*(\d+)", 1, message))
| where isnotempty(Total)
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by HostPoolName
| extend Deploying = coalesce(RunningDeployments, 0)
| project 
    Column1 = 'Total Hosts', Value1 = Total,
    Column2 = 'Enabled', Value2 = Enabled,
    Column3 = 'Target', Value3 = Target,
    Column4 = 'To Replace', Value4 = ToReplace,
    Column5 = 'In Drain', Value5 = InDrain,
    Column6 = 'Pending Delete', Value6 = PendingDelete,
    Column7 = 'Shutdown Retention', Value7 = ShutdownRetention,
    Column8 = 'To Deploy', Value8 = ToDeployNow,
    Column9 = 'Currently Deploying', Value9 = Deploying
| mv-expand Column = pack_array(Column1, Column2, Column3, Column4, Column5, Column6, Column7, Column8, Column9), Value = pack_array(Value1, Value2, Value3, Value4, Value5, Value6, Value7, Value8, Value9)
| project Column = tostring(Column), Value = toint(Value)
content.title: Last Reported Inventory

content.query:
let traces = AppTraces
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where _ResourceId in~ ({ApplicationInsights})
| extend timestamp = TimeGenerated, message = Message, severityLevel = SeverityLevel,
    customDimensions = Properties, cloud_RoleName = AppRoleName, cloud_RoleInstance = AppRoleInstance,
    operation_Id = OperationId, operation_Name = OperationName, itemCount = ItemCount;
let requests = AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where _ResourceId in~ ({ApplicationInsights})
| extend timestamp = TimeGenerated, name = Name, id = Id, duration = DurationMs, success = Success,
    resultCode = ResultCode, customDimensions = Properties, cloud_RoleName = AppRoleName,
    cloud_RoleInstance = AppRoleInstance, operation_Id = OperationId, operation_Name = OperationName, itemCount = ItemCount;
let hostPoolFilter = '{HostPool}';
let poolNames = traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where message contains 'SHR_TIMER |' or message contains 'SHR_EVENT |'
| extend HostPoolName = extract(@"^\[([^\]]+)\]", 1, message), Source = tostring(column_ifexists('_ResourceId', ''))
| where isnotempty(HostPoolName)
| summarize HostPoolName = take_any(HostPoolName) by Source, FunctionApp = cloud_RoleName;
let invocations = requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| extend FunctionName = replace_regex(name, @"^Functions\.", ''), Source = tostring(column_ifexists('_ResourceId', '')), FunctionApp = cloud_RoleName,
    InvocationKey = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions.InvocationId), tostring(customDimensions['prop__InvocationId']), id)
| where FunctionName in ('session-host-replacer-initiator', 'session-host-replacer-worker') and isnotempty(InvocationKey)
| extend Trigger = iff(FunctionName == 'session-host-replacer-worker', 'Reconciliation', 'Initiation')
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, duration, success) by Source, FunctionApp, Trigger, InvocationKey
| extend CompletedUtc = timestamp + (duration * 1ms)
| lookup kind=leftouter poolNames on Source, FunctionApp
| where hostPoolFilter == '*' or HostPoolName == hostPoolFilter;
let observations = invocations
| summarize ['Last Started'] = max(timestamp), ['Last Finished'] = max(CompletedUtc), ['Last Failure'] = maxif(CompletedUtc, success == false),
    arg_max(CompletedUtc, success) by Source, HostPoolName, FunctionApp, Trigger;
invocations
| distinct Source, HostPoolName, FunctionApp
| extend Trigger = dynamic(['Initiation', 'Reconciliation'])
| mv-expand Trigger to typeof(string)
| join kind=leftouter observations on Source, HostPoolName, FunctionApp, Trigger
| project ['Host Pool'] = HostPoolName, ['Function App'] = FunctionApp, Trigger, ['Last Started'], ['Last Finished'], ['Last Failure'],
    Observation = case(isnull(['Last Finished']), 'No completed invocation observed in selected range', isnull(success), 'Outcome unavailable', success == false, 'Failed - inspect invocation logs', 'Succeeded'),
    ['Minutes Since Finish'] = datetime_diff('minute', now(), ['Last Finished'])
| order by ['Host Pool'] asc, Trigger asc
content.title: Timer Health - Last Completed Invocations, Including Idle

content.query:
let traces = AppTraces
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where _ResourceId in~ ({ApplicationInsights})
| extend timestamp = TimeGenerated, message = Message, severityLevel = SeverityLevel,
    customDimensions = Properties, cloud_RoleName = AppRoleName, cloud_RoleInstance = AppRoleInstance,
    operation_Id = OperationId, operation_Name = OperationName, itemCount = ItemCount;
let hostPoolFilter = '{HostPool}';
let results = traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where message contains "ACTION |"
| extend HostPoolName = extract(@"\[([^\]]+)\]", 1, message)
| where isnotempty(HostPoolName)
| where hostPoolFilter == '*' or HostPoolName == hostPoolFilter
| extend Action = extract(@"ACTION \| (.+)$", 1, message)
| extend Category = case(
    Action startswith "Deployed:", "Deployed",
    Action == "FailedRecovery", "Failed Recovery",
    Action startswith "Deleted:", "Deleted",
    Action startswith "Draining:", "Draining",
    Action == "UpToDate", "Engine reported up to date",
    "Other engine observation"
)
| extend Hosts = toint(extract(@":(\d+)$", 1, Action))
| project Timestamp = timestamp, ['Host Pool'] = HostPoolName, Status = Category, Detail = Action, Hosts
| order by Timestamp desc
| take 50;
results
| union (datatable(Timestamp:datetime, ['Host Pool']:string, Status:string, Detail:string, Hosts:int) [datetime(null), 'No Data', 'No ACTION logs in selected time range', '', 0])
| where ['Host Pool'] != 'No Data' or toscalar(results | count) == 0
| take 50
content.title: Engine Action Observations - Not Cycle Completion

content.query:
let traces = AppTraces
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where _ResourceId in~ ({ApplicationInsights})
| extend timestamp = TimeGenerated, message = Message, severityLevel = SeverityLevel,
    customDimensions = Properties, cloud_RoleName = AppRoleName, cloud_RoleInstance = AppRoleInstance,
    operation_Id = OperationId, operation_Name = OperationName, itemCount = ItemCount;
let hostPoolFilter = '{HostPool}';
let results = traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where message contains "IMAGE_INFO"
| extend HostPoolName = extract(@"\[([^\]]+)\]", 1, message)
| where isnotempty(HostPoolName)

content.json:
---

💡 **Tip:** Use the time range selector at the top to adjust the dashboard view. For more detailed analysis, click on any chart to explore the underlying data in Application Insights.

### Invocation troubleshooting

Uses native completed request records in the workload workspace, independent of SHR Cycle selection. Includes only the current initiator and reconciliation worker, including idle invocations; the retired single-timer function is excluded. Select an invocation below to inspect its traces and exceptions. Missing native invocation IDs are shown as missing; request IDs are not relabeled. Logs can fall back to a nonempty native operation ID. Host-pool mapping requires a pool-prefixed trace in the selected time range; use **All Host Pools** when mapping is unavailable. Queries show the latest 200 invocations and 500 log records. Narrow the time range to inspect older executions. Sampling, log filtering, ingestion delay and retention can leave gaps; no rows do not prove health. This is not a replacement for the Portal invocation blade and does not change it.

parameters.name: TroubleshootingInvocation
parameters.label: Invocation to inspect
parameters.query:
let traces = AppTraces
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where _ResourceId in~ ({ApplicationInsights})
| extend timestamp = TimeGenerated, message = Message, severityLevel = SeverityLevel,
    customDimensions = Properties, cloud_RoleName = AppRoleName, cloud_RoleInstance = AppRoleInstance,
    operation_Id = OperationId, operation_Name = OperationName, itemCount = ItemCount;
let requests = AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where _ResourceId in~ ({ApplicationInsights})
| extend timestamp = TimeGenerated, name = Name, id = Id, duration = DurationMs, success = Success,
    resultCode = ResultCode, customDimensions = Properties, cloud_RoleName = AppRoleName,
    cloud_RoleInstance = AppRoleInstance, operation_Id = OperationId, operation_Name = OperationName, itemCount = ItemCount;
let poolNames = traces
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where message startswith '['
| extend HostPoolName = extract(@"^\[([^\]]+)\]", 1, message), Source = tostring(_ResourceId)
| where isnotempty(HostPoolName)
| summarize HostPoolName = take_any(HostPoolName) by Source, FunctionApp = cloud_RoleName;
let runs = requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| extend Source = tostring(_ResourceId), FunctionApp = cloud_RoleName,
    FunctionName = replace_regex(name, @"^Functions\.", ''),
    InvocationId = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions.InvocationId), tostring(customDimensions['prop__InvocationId']))
| where FunctionName in ('session-host-replacer-initiator', 'session-host-replacer-worker')
| extend InvocationKey = iff(isnotempty(InvocationId), strcat('inv:', InvocationId), strcat('req:', id))
| where InvocationKey !in ('inv:', 'req:')
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by Source, FunctionApp, FunctionName, InvocationKey
| lookup kind=leftouter poolNames on Source, FunctionApp
| where '{HostPool}' == '*' or HostPoolName == '{HostPool}'
| extend SelectionKey = strcat(Source, '|', InvocationKey), CompletedUtc = timestamp + (duration * 1ms),
    Outcome = case(isnull(success), 'Unavailable', success, 'Succeeded', 'Failed');
runs
| top 200 by timestamp desc
| project value = SelectionKey, label = strcat(format_datetime(timestamp, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), ' | ', FunctionApp, ' | ', FunctionName, ' | ', Outcome, ' | ', InvocationKey), selected = false
| union (datatable(value:string, label:string, selected:bool) ['*', 'Select an invocation (latest 200)', true])

let selectedRun = runs
| where SelectionKey == '{TroubleshootingInvocation}'
| project Source, SelectedInvocationId = InvocationId, SelectedOperationId = operation_Id;
union withsource=RecordType traces, exceptions
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| extend Source = tostring(_ResourceId),
    InvocationId = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions.InvocationId), tostring(customDimensions['prop__InvocationId']))
| join kind=inner selectedRun on Source
| where (isnotempty(InvocationId) and isnotempty(SelectedInvocationId) and InvocationId == SelectedInvocationId)
    or ((isempty(InvocationId) or isempty(SelectedInvocationId)) and isnotempty(operation_Id) and operation_Id == SelectedOperationId)
| project Timestamp = timestamp, RecordType, InvocationId, NativeOperationId = operation_Id,
    Category = tostring(customDimensions.Category), Severity = severityLevel,
    Message = coalesce(message, outerMessage, innermostMessage),
    ExceptionType = type, Details = details, RoleInstance = cloud_RoleInstance
| order by Timestamp desc
| take 500
| order by Timestamp asc
